newsitem.title: USA: Natural Wonders same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Natural Wonders same store sales rise.

text.p: Natural Wonders Inc said Thursday that sales for the five-week period ended January 4, 1997, increased 5.5 percent to $47,031,000 from $44,573,000 for the comparable five-week period ended January 6, 1996, which was adjusted for the calendar shift.
Comparable store sales were 2.2 percent above prior year.

Sales for the 48 week period ended January 4, 1997, increased 2.1 percent to $132,769,000 from $130,019,000 for the comparable period in 1995. Comparable store sales for the period were 0.6 percent below the prior year.

The company said, "We are very positive about our December performance, which recorded our first comparable store sales increase in four years for this important period. Although sales did not meet our plan, the margin percent came in better than plan due to less promotional activity and broad acceptance of our higher margin proprietary product, which has been one of our major strategic thrusts for 1996. Our inventory levels and assortment are in excellent shape to enter the new year."

Natural Wonders is a specialty retailer of unique and affordable family gifts inspired by the wonders of science and nature. The company operated 151 stores as of January 4, 1997, compared to 147 stores as of January 6, 1996.
